config.aeog.title: Anvil Enchantment Ordering Guide
config.aeog.autoDetectItem.tooltip:
When enabled, placing an item in the
anvil's left slot will automatically skip
Phase 1 and open Phase 2 for that item.
config.aeog.autoFillMode.tooltip.max:
Max Levels:
Automatically selects the maximum level
for every enchantment (excluding curses).
config.aeog.autoFillMode.tooltip.inv:
From Inventory:
Selects levels based on enchanted books
currently in your inventory.
config.aeog.allowIncompatible.tooltip:
Removes grouping and disabling of incompatible
enchantments in Phase 2. Only useful if you
have a mod/datapack that overrides vanilla
incompatibility rules.
